text:
Maria K: Heads up — we saw a recurring pattern during the 03:00 UTC surge: hedged queries + cross-zone spillover amplified queueing and pushed a few model pools into emergency admission control. logs attached.
Sam R: Ugh. Is this the same thing where hedging doubles peak tokens and we'd already been trending high on bursty image-to-text customers? :grimacing:
Maria K: Yep. Correlation looks strong. Hedged requests increased per-token load ~1.9x for some routes. The routing tiering kicked in but cross-zone spillover latched on and created hot queues in eu-west-1 and then us-west-2.
Ying L: Can you paste the relevant logs? I want to see the admission-control decisions.
Maria K: paste of recent excerpt:
```
[2026-03-18T03:02:11Z] route=/v1/chat model=redwood-xl-16b quant=fp16 tenant=acme tokens=420 hedged=true -> selected: local-pool-22
[2026-03-18T03:02:11Z] admission_decision: QUEUE (max_inflight=120, inflight=118)
[2026-03-18T03:02:11Z] fallback: cross-zone-spill to eu-west-1-pool-5
[2026-03-18T03:02:12Z] eu-west-1-pool-5 inflight++ -> 257 (cap=250) -> ADMIT_THROTTLE
```
Tomas G: That second line where inflight jumped to 257 is the classic amplification. Hedging sent the second speculative to another pool before the first was queued.
Noah P: We saw p95 tail decrease slightly but p99 worsened due to the extra queue hops and serialization across zones. Also cost spiked ~12% for that tenant during those 10m.
Ying L: So hedging reduces median but multiplies risk on capacity-constrained clusters. We need a policy to avoid cross-zone hedged duplicates from causing spillover.
Sam R: Ideas: 1) disabled global hedging when pool utilization > X, 2) prefer local fallback to quantized/cheaper model instead of sending hedges cross-zone, 3) per-tenant hedging budgets, 4) only hedge if KV cache miss + expected generation > threshold.
Maria K: I ran a quick sim. If we flip hedging to "local-first" and only allow hedges when local_pool_util < 0.7, cost delta goes from +12% to +2% while p99 latency improves for heavy clients. Trade: slightly higher cold tail.
Ying L: Can we instead change admission control to preempt hedged replicas: when inflight >= max_inflight-2 reject hedges but allow original? i.e., hedges get lower priority than original inflight tickets.
Tomas G: That seems doable: admission layer can check request metadata hedged=true and apply ``hedge_priority: low``. But racing windows still possible if original hasn't entered queue state.
Maria K: Proposed concrete changes (short):
- admission_control: mark hedged replicas as lower priority and never trigger cross-zone spill for hedged=true
- hedging_policy: local_only_when_util>0.6? (meaning disable sending hedges to other zones once local util>60%)
- model_fallback: attempt fallback to quantized variant (redwood-xl-16b-8bit) before sending cross-zone hedges
- hedging_budget: tenant-level token budget + global soft cap (configurable per plan)
Noah P: Also want a metric: hedged_load_ratio = hedged_tokens / total_tokens per pool. Add alert if > 0.15 and pool_util>0.75.
Sam R: +1. Add a short runbook entry: when hedged_load_ratio alert fires -> check top 5 tenants by hedged_tokens, toggle per-tenant hedging off if abnormal.
Ying L: We should also accept small kernel change: when routing to fallback model, set a slightly lower max_seq (e.g., 1024->768) to reduce token cost and avoid backpressure.
Maria K: Implementation plan: Tomas + Ying do admission change + metrics; Sam do runbook + alert; Noah do cost calc and per-tenant rate limit config; I'll prepare canary flag and docs.
Tomas G: I'll open a PR for the admission changes. Quick config draft (for rollout):
```
admission_control:
  max_inflight_per_model: 250
  hedged_policy:
    priority: low
    allow_cross_zone: false
    local_disable_threshold: 0.7
  fallback_order:
    - quantized_variant
    - smaller_model
    - cross_zone_hedge
```
Sam R: How do we toggle for canary? We need a feature flag per region + per-customer. Example curl to enable:
```
curl -X POST https://ops.api/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"hedge_local_first","value":true,"scope":"eu-west-1,us-west-2","tenants":["acme"]}'
```
Maria K: I'll push flag and enable for a single low-traffic tenant for 1h, measure hedged_load_ratio and cost. If green, roll to more tenants.
ingest-bot: uploaded logs: /internal/ingest/1847005678/hedge-incident-03-18.tar.gz
Noah P: FYI finance asked for a cost projection spreadsheet. I'll attach next. Short term goal: eliminate cross-zone hedged replicas unless original pool is healthy and under-utilized. Long term: smarter hedging that predicts completion time using KV cache state.
Ying L: Sounds good. I'll help with canary metrics dashboards (hedged_load_ratio, per-tenant hedged_tokens, p99 delta). :eyes:
Sam R: Thx team. Please tag me in PRs. We'll also add a note in the routing runbook about "hedge-friendly pools" vs "no-hedge pools".
Maria K: Thanks everyone. I'll create the follow-up threads for PR, runbook, and canary results. :thumbsup:
